property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: The record ID to load forms for

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the object (typically Contact)

property.name: languageFieldApiName
property.label: Language Field API Name
property.description: Contact field holding the preferred language. Set to English/Spanish to show corresponding forms.

property.name: divisionFieldApiName
property.label: Division Field API Name
property.description: Contact field holding Division (Member, Parent Provider, Provider, Tutor). Forms will be filtered to show only the matching Division category.

property.name: hideUnmappedForms
property.label: Hide forms without a template
property.description: Off by default. Check to hide forms that don't have a matching TS Documents template.

property.name: showUnmappedForms
property.label: Show unmapped forms (no longer used)
property.description: Retained for backward compatibility. Safe to delete once removed from all pages.
